summary: 22 features and 6 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • user-points: integrate UserPoints into achievement grains and app service (b0ad66d)
  • user-points: add UserPoints grain and grant subsystem (50bcf2d)
  • frontend-config: set default DailySalary to 1000 (991f635)
  • open-code-model: add provider-scoped model id fallback (e39836e)
  • hero-avatar: support development DLC version 0.0.0-dev (765b039)
  • omp: improve OMP CLI version detection and provider registration (879da5b)
  • omp: add Orleans grain infrastructure, monitoring, and profession preset (1aca050)
  • omp: add OMP CLI provider with models, extensions, and configuration (ef52408)
  • frontend-config: add salary tracker with per-second realtime counter (6889dd9)
  • hosting: register runtime hagitask options vaults from preset groups (8480dfe)
  • task-presets: add hagitask preset group support with PostConfigurer (d9750a0)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: render user text messages through markdown renderer (faccdb1)
  • profile: display user points and system timeline in profile drawer (c2aae7a)
  • userPoints: add user points API client, types, service, and store (7001bc2)
  • profile: add ProfileAvatarButton, ProfileAvatarSettings, and ProfileDrawer (c2c122d)
  • salary: add tick action, historical earning, and config sync listener (7976cbf)
  • profile: add profile drawer with avatar and quick links (e50e11a)
  • salary: add catchUp mechanism with historical total and config panel tab (fb2876c)
  • api: remove keyword tracking from proposal optimization bundle (d2101f3)
  • proposal: add scrollbar and auto-scroll props to repository selector (ad3d131)
  • salary: add salary tracker with settings panel and indicator (d8cd0bd)
  • omp: add OMP CLI executor and profession support (f7b831b)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • omp: normalize omniroute prefix in CLI provider model names (582ad49)
  • workflow: skip packaged preset group in runtime vault injection (3295e5c)
  • workflow: skip directory creation for bundled read-only vaults (1c8ef13)
  • health-probe: improve CLI version resolution with fallback paths (3249d3d)
  • streaming: preserve whitespace-only content and thinking chunks (601e624)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: harden markdown urlTransform against javascript: links (7ece5d5)
